title: Core existence of affine transition limit
statement: For every directed nonempty inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms, there exists a cone which is a limit.

proof.text: The full relative-spectrum construction and its universal property are the Stacks Limits Lemma 01YX argument; this intermediate theorem records that construction as the core existence step.

proof_origin: written from the Stacks Project proof
